text:
Maya: quick alert — after the 3.1.0 rollout some customers see inconsistent reranking results for embeddings-based search, small but reproducible
Owen: which cohort? any region-specific pattern?
Maya: mostly EU and one APAC account. similarity score distributions shifted downward ~5% for top-5
deploy-bot: [signal] model-quality-regression detected for embeddings:3.1.0. auto-rollback candidate: embeddings:3.0.7. autopilot: eligible but CHANGE-WINDOW lock present (global: 08:00-12:00 UTC)
Sam: we are inside change window; by policy autopilot is suppressed. do we want to escalate for an exception?
Tina: support flagged a paying customer on dedicated pool. if dedicated is impacted we should not wait.
Maya: proposal: pin only dedicated pools back to 3.0.7 immediately, keep hosted on 3.1.0 while we triage. reduces blast radius
Owen: can we do per-tenant routing? dedicated is per-customer so pin there should be quick. Hosting shared traffic is trickier
deploy-bot: [action] prepare pin for scope=dedicated -> embeddings:3.0.7. ETA 8m. progress 0/12 nodes
Maya: commands I'll run now:
Maya: ```
redwoodctl model pin embeddings --version 3.0.7 --scope dedicated
redwoodctl route set --pool customer-dedicated --model embeddings:3.0.7 --force
```
Sam: please add a changelog note and a customer-facing blurb before we flip traffic. Tina please draft, flag legal if needed
Tina: drafting: "We've observed a regression in similarity ranking for some queries after the 3.1.0 update. We've pinned your dedicated pool to the prior version (3.0.7) while we investigate."
ops-bot: notice: maintenance window in eu-central scheduled in 40m (FYI)
Owen: node 4 failed to pull 3.0.7 binary (checksum mismatch). investigating
Maya: rerun fetch and verify: `redwoodctl node fetch-binary 4 --model embeddings:3.0.7 && redwoodctl node verify 4`
Owen: fetch succeeded after mirror switch. progress 12/12. routing flipped for dedicated pools.
deploy-bot: [success] dedicated pools pinned and routed to embeddings:3.0.7. Observability: dedicated customers report restored ranking on synthetic checks
Maya: dedicated customers notified. Hosted still on 3.1.0. Should we consider full rollback?
Sam: risk tradeoff: hosted rollback would impact many customers during change window; but severity currently moderate. recommend monitor 2h and prepare staged host rollback plan if regressions persist
Tina: support posted the customer message and opened a follow-up ticket to confirm behavior in hosted after 30m
Owen: logging item for postmortem: release notes did not call out tokenizer changes. add a checklist item to include "backwards compatibility impact" in release notes for embedding model updates
Maya: also: autopilot suppression during change windows blocked an automatic reversion. let's add a safety-exception policy for severe quality regressions that can be invoked by SRE lead
deploy-bot: [info] manual intervention recorded: run-id r-7120003333-partial-pin. thread archived.
Sam: thanks team. i'll prepare a short incident summary and action items for tomorrow's postmortem. :thumbsup:
